description: Bagandati ni e’yo ba Buganda vu ni a’yo ni, Uganda tialia, Kampala ka taun ngbangba alia.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lugbara courses (#132) with low confidence in Lugbara; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: E’yo **Kampala ka Uganda tialia ni.**
why.text: Bagandati ni e’yo ba ambo Uganda tialia a’yo ni, ka eri ni e’yo suku ka taun Kampala ni. Imba aku ba ni e’yo a’yozu si, agyi ndrezu suku alia, ka jo ovuzu muke geri dria.

cards.title: Aku ba ni
cards.text: A’yo atibi ka dede be ka imba fe anzi ni e’yo nde.

cards.title: Ba ndi geri dria ni
cards.text: Inzi bayi, a’yo afayi ru ka mu mi ofo ku.

cards.title: Ba le e’yo ni ni
cards.text: Ndre Buganda ovu yi ni ka e’yo ndra’bo niyi.

landing.audience: Ba Lugbarati a’yo ni etozu ni, aku bayi ni le e’yo a’yo Buganda vu ni be, ka ba ndi geri dria Uganda tialia ni.
landing.first: Ngoni, ru a’yozu ka nde, vutia aku ba, nyaka, suku, sawa, vu, jo ka ruakini, alu alu.

cast.emma: Uji imba Bagandati ndi geri dria ndraa
